name: common_logger
usage_rules: Business scripts: replace all print() with sys_logger.<level>().
Entry/test/agent startup: call set_debug_mode() once to control verbosity.
Levels: debug=details; info=milestones; warning=recoverable; error=fail+raise; critical=fatal.

risky_section: with CriticalSection('pywin32 CAD call') as cs:

pitfalls: INFO not shown when log level is WARNING (filtered, not missing).
Excel not written if openpyxl missing or xlsx locked by Excel.
Do not call set_debug_mode() in many modules (inconsistent behavior).
